source.text: שִׁ֗יר הַֽמַּ֫עֲל֥וֹתאֵ֭לֶיךָ נָשָׂ֣אתִי אֶת־עֵינַ֑י הַ֝יֹּשְׁבִ֗י בַּשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: The song of the ascents. To you I have lifted up my eyes, the [one] sitting in the heavens.

en.L: A song of ascents. \q To {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I lift up my eyes, \q [the one] sitting in the heavens.
en.B: A song of ascents. \q I raise my eyes to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q the one who reigns in heaven.
en.R: A song for the journey up to Jerusalem. \q I look up to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q You sit on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} throne in heaven.

fr.L: Cantique des montées. \q Vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} je lève mes yeux, \q [{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui] sièges dans les cieux.
fr.B: Cantique des montées. \q Je lève les yeux vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, \q qui règnes dans les cieux.
fr.R: Chant pour la montée vers Jérusalem. \q Je lève les yeux vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q Tu es assis sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} trône dans le ciel.

sw.L: Wimbo wa kupanda. \q Kwako ninainua macho yangu, \q ewe uketiye mbinguni.
sw.B: Wimbo wa kupanda. \q Ninainua macho yangu kukutazama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, \q unayetawala mbinguni.
sw.R: Wimbo wa safari ya kupanda kwenda Yerusalemu. \q Ninakutazama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. \q Umeketi katika kiti {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} cha enzi mbinguni.

es.L: Cántico de las subidas. \q Hacia {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} alzo mis ojos, \q [el que] está sentado en los cielos.
es.B: Cántico de las subidas. \q Levanto mis ojos hacia {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, \q el que reina en el cielo.
es.R: Canto para el viaje de subida a Jerusalén. \q Miro hacia {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Tú estás sentado en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} trono en el cielo.

vi.L: Bài ca cho những lần đi lên. \q Tôi ngước mắt lên cùng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q [Đấng] ngự trên các tầng trời.
vi.B: Bài ca đi lên. \q Tôi ngước mắt nhìn lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q là Đấng ngự trị trên trời.
vi.R: Bài ca cho cuộc hành trình lên Giê-ru-sa-lem. \q Tôi ngước nhìn lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài ngồi trên ngai của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở trên trời.

ko.L: 올라감을 위한 노래. \q 주님께 제가 제 눈을 듭니다, \q 하늘에 앉아 계신 분이시여.
ko.B: 올라가며 부르는 노래. \q 하늘에서 다스리시는 주님, \q 제가 주님께 눈을 듭니다.
ko.R: 예루살렘으로 올라가며 부르는 노래. \q 제가 주님을 올려다봅니다. \q 주님께서는 하늘에서 보좌에 앉아 계십니다.

pt.L: Cântico dos degraus. \q Para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} levanto os meus olhos, \q [{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} que estás] sentado nos céus.
pt.B: Cântico das subidas. \q Ergo os olhos para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, \q que reinas no céu.
pt.R: Canção para a subida a Jerusalém. \q Olho para {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. \q Tu estás sentado no {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} trono no céu.

am.L: የመውጣት መዝሙር። \q በሰማያት የምትቀመጥ ሆይ፣ \q ዓይኖቼን ወደ አንተ አነሣለሁ።
am.B: የመውጣት መዝሙር። \q በሰማይ የምትነግሥ ሆይ፣ \q ዓይኖቼን ወደ አንተ አቀናለሁ።
am.R: የመውጣት መዝሙር፤ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ሲወጡ የሚዘመር። \q ቀና ብዬ ወደ አንተ እመለከታለሁ። \q አንተ በሰማይ በዙፋንህ ላይ ተቀምጠሃል።

hi.L: चढ़ाई का गीत। \q तेरी ओर मैं अपनी आँखें उठाता हूँ, \q [हे] स्वर्ग में विराजमान।
hi.B: चढ़ाई का गीत। \q हे स्वर्ग में राज्य करनेवाले, \q मैं अपनी आँखें तेरी ओर उठाता हूँ।
hi.R: यरूशलेम की ओर जाने की यात्रा का गीत। \q मैं तेरी ओर देखता हूँ। \q तू स्वर्ग में अपने सिंहासन पर बैठा है।

ru.L: Песнь восхождения. \q К {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} поднимаю я глаза мои, [к тому, \q кто] восседает на небесах.
ru.B: Песнь восхождения. \q Я поднимаю глаза к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, \q царствующему на небесах.
ru.R: Песня для пути в Иерусалим. \q Я смотрю вверх, на {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}. \q Ты сидишь на своём престоле на небесах.

ja.L: 上りの歌。 \q あなたに、わたしは目を上げる、 \q 天に座しておられる方よ。
ja.B: 都に上る歌。 \q 天で治めておられる方よ、 \q わたしはあなたを見上げる。
ja.R: エルサレムへ上る旅の歌。 \q わたしは、あなたを見上げる。 \q あなたは天の王座に座っておられる。

uk.L: Пісня сходжень. \q До {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} я підношу мої очі, [до того, \q хто] сидить на небесах.
uk.B: Пісня сходжень. \q Я підношу очі до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, \q хто царює на небесах.
uk.R: Пісня для подорожі вгору до Єрусалима. \q Я дивлюся вгору, на {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. \q Ти сидиш на своєму престолі на небі.

id.L: Nyanyian untuk perjalanan naik. \q Kepada-{{deity_pronoun:mu|Mu}} aku mengangkat mataku, \q [hai {{deity_pronoun:engkau|Engkau}}] yang bersemayam di surga.
id.B: Nyanyian ziarah. \q Aku mengarahkan mataku kepada-{{deity_pronoun:mu|Mu}}, \q yang memerintah di surga.
id.R: Nyanyian untuk perjalanan naik ke Yerusalem. \q Aku memandang kepada-{{deity_pronoun:mu|Mu}}. \q Engkau duduk di atas takhta-{{deity_pronoun:mu|Mu}} di surga.

tl.L: Isang awit ng pag-akyat. \q Sa {{deity_pronoun:iyo|Iyo}} ko itinitingin ang aking mga mata, \q {{deity_pronoun:ikaw|Ikaw}} na nakaupo sa kalangitan.
tl.B: Isang awit ng pag-akyat. \q Itinitingala ko ang aking mga mata sa {{deity_pronoun:iyo|Iyo}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:ikaw|Ikaw}} na naghahari sa langit.
tl.R: Isang awit para sa paglalakbay paakyat sa Jerusalem. \q Tumitingala ako sa {{deity_pronoun:iyo|Iyo}}. \q Nakaupo {{deity_pronoun:ka|Ka}} sa {{deity_pronoun:iyong|Iyong}} trono sa langit.

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: As in 120:1, the short title and the first line are counted together as verse 1, so the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: a song of ascents: probably a pilgrim song
decisions.reason: As in 120:1: one of the fifteen songs probably sung by pilgrims going up to Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: sitting: sitting enthroned
decisions.reason: The verb (yashav) used of God means sitting as king on his throne (2:4; 29:10).

decisions.choice: I have lifted up: I lift up now
decisions.reason: The verb is in the form often used for past events, but here it describes what the psalmist is doing now.

decisions.choice: A song for the journey up to Jerusalem
decisions.reason: As in 120:1.

decisions.choice: reigns (B); sit on your throne (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what God's sitting means (m3).

decisions.choice: "Ngài" for "you" as the singer speaks to God
decisions.reason: As in the published Psalms 23 and 139, the psalmist speaks to God as "Ngài", with the deity_pronoun setting the English has.

decisions.choice: The prayer to God is in 합쇼체 with "저/제"; the Hebrew "you" is the title "주님", with no span
decisions.reason: Style guide section 7a. Korean addresses God by title rather than a pronoun; "주님" here is not the divine name, so it carries no divine_name span.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of Psalm 123.
alternatives: spans like the English ones (from verse 1)
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic.

decisions.choice: "the one sitting in the heavens" as "በሰማያት የምትቀመጥ" (Literal), "በሰማይ የምትነግሥ" (Balanced), "በዙፋንህ ላይ ተቀምጠሃል" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb pictures God sitting enthroned (meaning decision m3); Balanced and Readable say so, as the English does.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans
decisions.reason: Devanagari has no capital letters, so the deity_pronoun setting has nothing to change in Hindi; the psalmist speaks to God with the devotional "तू", and God spoken of takes the honorific plural.

decisions.choice: "विराजमान" (L); "राज्य करनेवाले" (B); "अपने सिंहासन पर बैठा है" (R)
decisions.reason: God's sitting is sitting enthroned (meaning m3). Literal "विराजमान" is the Hindi word for a dignified sitting and keeps the picture; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Песнь восхождения (L, B); Песня для пути в Иерусалим (R)
decisions.reason: As in 120:1: one form of the title per level through the Songs of Ascents.

decisions.choice: hayyoshevi bashshamayim "天に座しておられる方" (L), "天で治めておられる方" (B), "天の王座に座っておられる" (R)
decisions.reason: Sitting means sitting enthroned (m3); B and R make the rule explicit as the English does. God addressed あなた, plain, with respect forms.

decisions.choice: "Isang awit ng pag-akyat"
decisions.reason: Song of ascents: sung on the way up to Jerusalem for the feasts (m1).

source.text: הִנֵּ֨ה כְעֵינֵ֪י עֲבָדִ֡ים אֶל־יַ֤ד אֲֽדוֹנֵיהֶ֗ם כְּעֵינֵ֣י שִׁפְחָה֮ אֶל־יַ֪ד גְּבִ֫רְתָּ֥הּ כֵּ֣ן עֵ֭ינֵינוּ אֶל־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ עַ֝֗ד שֶׁיְּחָנֵּֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, as [the] eyes of slaves to [the] hand of their masters, as [the] eyes of a female slave to [the] hand of her mistress, so our eyes [are] to YHWH our God until that he shows us favor.

en.L: Look, as the eyes of slaves [are] to the hand of their masters, \q as the eyes of a female slave [are] to the hand of her mistress, \q so our eyes [are] to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God \q until {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shows us favor.
en.B: Servants watch the hand of their master, \q and a servant woman watches the hand of the woman she serves. \q In the same way we keep our eyes on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God, \q waiting for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to show us favor.
en.R: Servants keep watching their master's hand to see what he wants or what he will give. \q A servant woman watches the hand of the woman she works for. \q In the same way, we keep looking to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our God. \q We wait for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} to be kind to us.

fr.L: Voici, comme les yeux des esclaves [sont] vers la main de leurs maîtres, \q comme les yeux d’une esclave [sont] vers la main de sa maîtresse, \q ainsi nos yeux [sont] vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, \q jusqu’à ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous fasse grâce.
fr.B: Les serviteurs regardent la main de leur maître, \q et la servante regarde la main de sa maîtresse. \q De même, nous gardons les yeux fixés sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu, \q en attendant qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous fasse grâce.
fr.R: Les serviteurs regardent sans cesse la main de leur maître pour voir ce qu’il veut ou ce qu’il va leur donner. \q La servante regarde la main de la femme pour qui elle travaille. \q De même, nous ne quittons pas des yeux {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} notre Dieu. \q Nous attendons qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} soit bon pour nous.

sw.L: Tazama, kama macho ya watumwa [yalivyo] kwa mkono wa mabwana wao, \q kama macho ya mjakazi [yalivyo] kwa mkono wa bibi yake, \q ndivyo macho yetu [yalivyo] kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu mpaka atakapotuhurumia.
sw.B: Watumishi huutazama mkono wa bwana wao, na mtumishi wa kike huutazama mkono wa bibi anayemtumikia. \q Vivyo hivyo tunaendelea kumtazama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu, \q tukimngoja atuhurumie.
sw.R: Watumishi huendelea kuutazama mkono wa bwana wao ili waone anachotaka au atakachowapa. \q Mtumishi wa kike huutazama mkono wa bibi anayemfanyia kazi. \q Vivyo hivyo, sisi tunaendelea kumtazama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wetu. \q Tunamngoja atuonee wema.

es.L: Mira, como los ojos de los esclavos [están puestos] en la mano de sus señores, \q como los ojos de la esclava [están puestos] en la mano de su señora, \q así nuestros ojos [están puestos] en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, \q hasta que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos muestre su favor.
es.B: Los siervos observan la mano de su señor, \q y la sierva observa la mano de la mujer a quien sirve. \q Así también nosotros tenemos los ojos puestos en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Dios, \q esperando que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} nos muestre su favor.
es.R: Los siervos no dejan de mirar la mano de su amo para ver qué quiere o qué les va a dar. \q La sierva mira la mano de la mujer para quien trabaja. \q Así también nosotros seguimos mirando {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} nuestro Dios. \q Esperamos que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sea bondadoso con nosotros.

vi.L: Này, như mắt của những nô lệ [hướng] về tay của chủ mình, \q như mắt của nữ nô lệ [hướng] về tay của bà chủ mình, thì mắt chúng tôi [hướng] về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi, cho đến khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tỏ ơn cho chúng tôi.
vi.B: Đầy tớ dõi theo tay của chủ mình, và người tớ gái dõi theo tay của bà chủ mình. Cũng vậy, mắt chúng tôi hướng về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi, \q chờ đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tỏ ơn cho chúng tôi.
vi.R: Đầy tớ cứ nhìn theo tay của chủ mình, để xem chủ muốn gì hay sẽ cho gì. \q Người tớ gái nhìn theo tay của bà chủ mình. \q Cũng vậy, chúng tôi cứ trông lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời chúng tôi. \q Chúng tôi chờ đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tỏ lòng thương xót chúng tôi.

ko.L: 보아라, 종들의 눈이 그들 주인의 손을 [향하듯], \q 여종의 눈이 그 여주인의 손을 [향하듯], \q 우리 눈이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님을 [향하니], 그분께서 우리에게 은혜를 베푸실 때까지이다.
ko.B: 종들은 주인의 손을 지켜보고, 여종은 자기가 섬기는 여주인의 손을 지켜본다. \q 그처럼 우리도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님께 눈을 두고, \q 그분께서 우리에게 은혜를 베풀어 주시기를 기다린다.
ko.R: 종들은 주인이 무엇을 원하는지, 무엇을 줄지 알려고 주인의 손을 계속 지켜본다. \q 여종은 자기가 일하는 집 여주인의 손을 지켜본다. \q 그처럼 우리도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 우리 하나님을 계속 바라본다. \q 그분께서 우리에게 친절을 베푸시기를 기다린다.

pt.L: Eis que, como os olhos dos escravos [estão voltados] para a mão dos seus senhores, \q como os olhos da escrava [estão voltados] para a mão da sua senhora, \q assim os nossos olhos [estão voltados] para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, nosso Deus, \q até que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} seja gracioso conosco.
pt.B: Os servos observam a mão do seu senhor, \q e a serva observa a mão da mulher a quem serve. \q Do mesmo modo, mantemos os olhos {{divine_name:no SENHOR|em Javé}}, nosso Deus, \q esperando que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} nos mostre a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} graça.
pt.R: Os servos ficam olhando para a mão do seu senhor, para ver o que ele quer ou o que vai dar. \q A serva fica olhando para a mão da mulher para quem trabalha. \q Do mesmo jeito, nós continuamos olhando para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o nosso Deus. \q Esperamos que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} seja bondoso conosco.

am.L: እነሆ፣ የባሪያዎች ዓይኖች ወደ ጌቶቻቸው እጅ፣ \q የባሪያይቱም ዓይኖች ወደ እመቤቷ እጅ እንደ [ሆኑ]፣ \q እንዲሁ ዓይኖቻችን እስኪራራልን ድረስ ወደ አምላካችን ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} [ናቸው]።
am.B: አገልጋዮች የጌታቸውን እጅ ይመለከታሉ፤ አገልጋይቱም የምታገለግላትን እመቤት እጅ ትመለከታለች። \q እንዲሁ እኛም እስኪራራልን ድረስ ዓይኖቻችንን በአምላካችን {{divine_name:በእግዚአብሔር|በያህዌ}} ላይ እናደርጋለን።
am.R: አገልጋዮች ጌታቸው የሚፈልገውን ወይም የሚሰጣቸውን ለማየት እጁን ይመለከታሉ። \q አገልጋይቱም የምትሠራላትን እመቤት እጅ ትመለከታለች። \q እንዲሁ እኛም ወደ አምላካችን ወደ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} መመልከታችንን አናቋርጥም። \q ቸርነቱን እስኪያሳየን ድረስ እንጠብቃለን።

hi.L: देखो, जैसे दासों की आँखें अपने स्वामियों के हाथ की ओर [लगी रहती हैं], \q जैसे दासी की आँखें अपनी स्वामिनी के हाथ की ओर [लगी रहती हैं], \q वैसे ही हमारी आँखें {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हमारे परमेश्वर की ओर [लगी हैं], \q जब तक वे हम पर अनुग्रह न करें।
hi.B: दास अपने स्वामी के हाथ की ओर ताकते रहते हैं, \q और दासी अपनी स्वामिनी के हाथ की ओर ताकती रहती है। \q उसी तरह हम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की ओर आँखें लगाए रहते हैं, \q और प्रतीक्षा करते हैं कि वे हम पर अनुग्रह करें।
hi.R: दास अपने मालिक के हाथ की ओर देखते रहते हैं कि वह क्या चाहता है या क्या देगा। \q दासी उस स्त्री के हाथ की ओर देखती रहती है जिसकी वह सेवा करती है। \q उसी तरह हम {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} अपने परमेश्वर की ओर देखते रहते हैं। \q हम राह देखते हैं कि वे हम पर कृपा करें।

ru.L: Вот, как глаза рабов — на руку господ их, \q как глаза рабыни — на руку госпожи её, \q так глаза наши — на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, Бога нашего, \q пока {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} не помилует нас.
ru.B: Рабы следят за рукой своего господина, \q и рабыня следит за рукой своей госпожи. \q Так и мы не сводим глаз с {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога, \q ожидая, когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} помилует нас.
ru.R: Рабы не сводят глаз с руки своего господина, чтобы понять, чего он хочет или что он даст. \q Рабыня смотрит на руку своей госпожи. \q Так и мы всё время смотрим на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, нашего Бога. \q Мы ждём, когда {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} будет добр к нам.

ja.L: ああ、奴隷たちの目が主人たちの手に[向けられ]、女奴隷の目が女主人の手に[向けられる]ように、そのように、わたしたちの目は{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}、 \q わたしたちの神に[向けられる]、 \q その方がわたしたちをあわれんでくださるまで。
ja.B: しもべたちは主人の手を見つめ、はしためは女主人の手を見つめる。 \q そのように、わたしたちは、わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}から目を離さず、 \q その方が恵みを示してくださるのを待つ。
ja.R: しもべたちは、主人が何を望み、何をくれるかを知ろうとして、主人の手をじっと見ている。女のしもべも、自分が仕える女主人の手を見ている。 \q 同じように、わたしたちも、わたしたちの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を見上げ続ける。 \q その方が、わたしたちにやさしくしてくださるのを待っている。

uk.L: Ось, як очі рабів — до руки їхніх панів, як очі рабині — до руки її пані, так наші очі — до {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, \q нашого Бога, \q доки {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} не змилується над нами.
uk.B: Раби стежать за рукою свого пана, а рабиня стежить за рукою жінки, якій служить. \q Так само й ми не зводимо очей з {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога, і чекаємо, \q щоб {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} змилувався над нами.
uk.R: Слуги весь час дивляться на руку свого пана, щоб побачити, чого він хоче або що він дасть. Служниця дивиться на руку жінки, на яку працює. \q Так само й ми дивимося на {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Ягве}}, нашого Бога. \q Ми чекаємо, щоб {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} був добрим до нас.

id.L: Lihatlah, seperti mata para budak [tertuju] kepada tangan tuan-tuan mereka, \q seperti mata seorang budak perempuan [tertuju] kepada tangan nyonyanya, \q demikianlah mata kita [tertuju] kepada {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kita, \q sampai {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} menunjukkan kemurahan kepada kita.
id.B: Para hamba memperhatikan tangan tuannya, \q dan seorang hamba perempuan memperhatikan tangan nyonya yang dilayaninya. \q Demikian juga mata kita tertuju kepada {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kita, \q menantikan {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} menunjukkan kemurahan-{{deity_pronoun:nya|Nya}} kepada kita.
id.R: Para hamba terus memperhatikan tangan tuannya untuk mengetahui apa yang dia inginkan atau apa yang akan dia berikan. \q Seorang hamba perempuan memperhatikan tangan nyonya tempat dia bekerja. \q Begitu juga, kita terus memandang kepada {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, Allah kita. \q Kita menunggu {{deity_pronoun:dia|Dia}} berbaik hati kepada kita.

tl.L: Narito, gaya ng mga mata ng mga alipin sa kamay ng kanilang mga panginoon, \q gaya ng mga mata ng aliping babae sa kamay ng kaniyang among babae, \q gayon ang aming mga mata {{divine_name:sa PANGINOON|kay Yahweh}} na aming Diyos \q hanggang sa pakitaan {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} kami ng biyaya.
tl.B: Binabantayan ng mga alipin ang kamay ng kanilang panginoon, \q at binabantayan ng aliping babae ang kamay ng babaing kaniyang pinaglilingkuran. \q Gayundin naman, itinutuon namin ang aming mga mata {{divine_name:sa PANGINOON|kay Yahweh}} na aming Diyos, \q naghihintay na pakitaan {{deity_pronoun:niya|Niya}} kami ng biyaya.
tl.R: Patuloy na binabantayan ng mga alipin ang kamay ng kanilang amo upang makita kung ano ang gusto o ibibigay nito. \q Binabantayan ng aliping babae ang kamay ng babaing pinagtatrabahuhan niya. \q Gayundin naman, patuloy kaming umaasa {{divine_name:sa PANGINOON|kay Yahweh}} na aming Diyos. \q Hinihintay naming maging mabait {{deity_pronoun:siya|Siya}} sa amin.

decisions.choice: the hand of their master: signal and gift
decisions.reason: Slaves watched the master's hand for a sign of what was wanted, for the food and wages it handed out, and for help. The picture is of complete attention and dependence.

decisions.choice: show favor: be gracious
decisions.reason: The verb (chanan) means to show undeserved kindness to someone in need. It is repeated twice in verse 3.

decisions.choice: masters: plural of majesty or each one's master
decisions.reason: The word for "their master" is plural in form, as it often is for a master or lord; it may also mean each slave's own master.

decisions.choice: to see what he wants or what he will give
decisions.reason: Readable explains why the servants watch the hand (m1).

decisions.choice: servants; servant woman
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m1) keeps that these are slaves watching a master, and Literal keeps "slaves" and "female slave".

decisions.choice: "esclaves", "une esclave" (Literal); "serviteurs", "la servante" (Balanced, Readable) for ʿavadim and shifḥah
decisions.reason: As the French terms set for ʿeved: "esclave" at Literal, "serviteur" at Balanced and Readable, as the English does. The feminine shifḥah follows the same pattern.

decisions.choice: "kuhurumia" (L, B) for showing favor; "kuonea wema" (be kind to) at Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew asks God to be gracious. "Kuhurumia" is the everyday word for showing undeserved kindness to someone in need; "fadhili" is kept for the Hebrew hesed (loyal love) in these psalms, so it is not used here.

decisions.choice: esclavos, esclava (L); siervos, sierva (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew 'eved and shifchah are slaves. Literal says "esclavos" and "esclava"; Balanced and Readable say "siervos" and "sierva", as the English says "servants", following the book-wide choice for 'eved.

decisions.choice: "nô lệ", "nữ nô lệ" (L); "đầy tớ", "người tớ gái" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is the one for a slave, and Literal keeps that; Balanced and Readable say "servant" for people who wait on their master's hand, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Verse 2 speaks about the LORD in the plain written style with the honorific, between the prayers of verses 1 and 3
alternatives: 합쇼체 with 저희 throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: The verse names "the LORD our God" and "he" in the third person, so it is speech about God (style guide section 7a); verses 1, 3 and 4 speak to him.

decisions.choice: seja gracioso conosco (L); nos mostre a sua graça (B); seja bondoso conosco (R)
decisions.reason: Chanan (m2), here and twice in verse 3, takes the Psalms' wording for the whole book at each level ("sê gracioso", "mostra-me a tua graça", "sê bondoso"), turned to the third person here; "misericórdia" is kept for other words.

decisions.choice: show favor (ḥanan) as "ራራ" ("እስኪራራልን", Literal and Balanced; Readable "ቸርነቱን እስኪያሳየን"), the same verb in verse 3
decisions.reason: The verb is God's free kindness (meaning decision m2); "ራራ" is that sense in plain Amharic, and keeps the link with verse 3's repeated cry.

decisions.choice: slaves as "አገልጋዮች" and the female slave as "አገልጋይቱ" (Balanced, Readable); Literal "ባሪያዎች", "ባሪያይቱ"
decisions.reason: The picture is of servants waiting on a signal (meaning decision m1); Balanced and Readable say "servants", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "दास", "दासी" at every level
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable say "servants"; the Pentateuch note keeps "दास" for ʿeved at every level, and the picture is of slaves watching a master's hand (meaning m1).

decisions.choice: "अनुग्रह करना" (L, B); "कृपा करना" (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is to be gracious, to show favour (meaning m2), in this verse and twice in verse 3. Readable uses the everyday "कृपा".

decisions.choice: рабы; рабыня (every level)
decisions.reason: The English says "servants" at Balanced and Readable; the Pentateuch note keeps раб for 'eved at every level, as the New Testament does, and the picture (m1) is of slaves watching a master's hand, so Russian keeps рабы and рабыня.

decisions.choice: 'avadim / shifchah "奴隷たち" / "女奴隷" (L), "しもべたち" / "はしため" (B), "しもべたち" / "女のしもべ" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English (slave at L, servant at B and R); PSA-1 notes 123:2 among the places where the English L says slave.

decisions.choice: hinneh "ああ" (L), dropped (B, R); yechonnenu "あわれんでくださる" (L), "恵みを示してくださる" (B), "やさしくしてくださる" (R)
decisions.reason: Psalter rules: hinneh never 見よ; chanan あわれむ (L), 恵みを示す (B); R follows the English R "be kind to us".

decisions.choice: "слуги", "служниця" (R) for the slaves of the picture
decisions.reason: The Readable English speaks of servants watching for their master's wishes; Literal and Balanced keep "раби" for ʿeved.

decisions.choice: "budak" (L), "hamba" (B, R); "kita" in verses 2-4
decisions.reason: The servant watches the master's hand for a signal and a gift (m1, uncertain); the worshipers speak of themselves together, so "kita".

decisions.choice: "kamay ng kanilang mga panginoon"
decisions.reason: The master's hand: servants watch for a sign (m1).

alignments.target_span: その方が恵みを示してくださる

source.text: חָנֵּ֣נוּ יְהוָ֣ה חָנֵּ֑נוּ כִּֽי־רַ֝֗ב שָׂבַ֥עְנוּ בֽוּז׃

records.literal_gloss: Show us favor, YHWH, show us favor, for much we have been filled [with] contempt.

en.L: Show us favor, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, show us favor, \q for we have been greatly filled [with] contempt.
en.B: Show us favor, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, show us favor, \q for we have swallowed more contempt than we can bear.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, be kind to us! Be kind to us! \q People have looked down on us more than we can stand.

fr.L: Fais-nous grâce, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, fais-nous grâce, \q car nous avons été grandement rassasiés de mépris.
fr.B: Fais-nous grâce, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, fais-nous grâce, \q car nous avons avalé plus de mépris que nous n’en pouvons supporter.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sois bon pour nous ! Sois bon pour nous ! \q Les gens nous ont méprisés plus que nous ne pouvons le supporter.

sw.L: Utuhurumie, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, utuhurumie, \q kwa maana tumeshibishwa sana dharau.
sw.B: Utuhurumie, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, utuhurumie, \q kwa maana tumemeza dharau kuliko tunavyoweza kustahimili.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, utuonee wema! Utuonee wema! \q Watu wametudharau kuliko tunavyoweza kuvumilia.

es.L: Muéstranos tu favor, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, muéstranos tu favor, \q porque estamos muy hartos [de] desprecio.
es.B: Muéstranos tu favor, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, muéstranos tu favor, \q porque hemos tragado más desprecio del que podemos soportar.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡sé bondadoso con nosotros! ¡Sé bondadoso con nosotros! \q La gente nos ha despreciado más de lo que podemos aguantar.

vi.L: Xin tỏ ơn cho chúng tôi, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin tỏ ơn cho chúng tôi, \q vì chúng tôi đã bị no nê sự khinh miệt quá nhiều.
vi.B: Xin tỏ ơn cho chúng tôi, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin tỏ ơn cho chúng tôi, \q vì chúng tôi đã phải nuốt sự khinh miệt nhiều hơn sức mình chịu nổi.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin thương xót chúng tôi! Xin thương xót chúng tôi! \q Người ta đã khinh dể chúng tôi đến mức chúng tôi không chịu nổi nữa.

ko.L: 저희에게 은혜를 베풀어 주십시오, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, \q 저희에게 은혜를 베풀어 주십시오. 저희가 멸시로 너무나 배불러졌습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 은혜를 베풀어 주십시오. 저희에게 은혜를 베풀어 주십시오. \q 저희는 견딜 수 없을 만큼 멸시를 삼켰습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저희에게 친절을 베풀어 주십시오! 저희에게 친절을 베풀어 주십시오! \q 사람들이 저희를 견딜 수 없을 만큼 업신여겼습니다.

pt.L: Sê gracioso conosco, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, sê gracioso conosco, \q porque estamos muito fartos de desprezo.
pt.B: Mostra-nos a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} graça, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, mostra-nos a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} graça, \q porque já engolimos mais desprezo do que conseguimos suportar.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, sê bondoso conosco! Sê bondoso conosco! \q As pessoas nos desprezaram mais do que conseguimos aguentar.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ራራልን፤ \q ራራልን፤ ንቀትን እጅግ ጠግበናልና።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ራራልን፤ ራራልን፤ \q ከምንችለው በላይ ንቀት ተጋተናልና።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ቸርነትህን አሳየን! ቸርነትህን አሳየን! \q ሰዎች ልንሸከመው ከምንችለው በላይ ናቁን።

hi.L: हम पर अनुग्रह कर, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, \q हम पर अनुग्रह कर, क्योंकि हम तिरस्कार से बहुत भर गए हैं।
hi.B: हम पर अनुग्रह कर, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, हम पर अनुग्रह कर, \q क्योंकि हमने सहने से अधिक तिरस्कार झेला है।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, हम पर कृपा कर! हम पर कृपा कर! \q लोगों ने हमें इतना नीचा दिखाया है कि अब सहा नहीं जाता।

ru.L: Помилуй нас, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, помилуй нас, \q ведь мы сильно пресыщены презрением.
ru.B: Помилуй нас, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, помилуй нас, \q ведь мы проглотили больше презрения, чем можем вынести.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, будь добр к нам! Будь добр к нам! \q Люди презирали нас больше, чем мы можем вынести.

ja.L: あわれんでください、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしたちをあわれんでください。 \q わたしたちは、さげすみに十分すぎるほど満たされたからだ。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしたちに恵みを示してください。 \q 恵みを示してください。わたしたちは、耐えきれないほどのさげすみを受けてきた。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしたちにやさしくしてください！やさしくしてください！ \q わたしたちは、もう耐えられないほど、人々に見下されてきた。

uk.L: Змилуйся над нами, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, \q змилуйся над нами, бо ми дуже наситилися зневагою.
uk.B: Змилуйся над нами, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, змилуйся над нами, \q бо ми проковтнули більше зневаги, ніж можемо витримати.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, будь добрим до нас! Будь добрим до нас! \q Люди дивилися на нас зверхньо більше, ніж ми можемо витерпіти.

id.L: Kasihanilah kami, ya {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, kasihanilah kami, \q sebab kami sudah sangat kenyang [dengan] penghinaan.
id.B: Tunjukkanlah kemurahan kepada kami, ya {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, tunjukkanlah kemurahan kepada kami, \q sebab kami sudah menelan penghinaan lebih dari yang dapat kami tanggung.
id.R: Ya {{divine_name:TUHAN|Yahweh}}, berbaik hatilah kepada kami! Berbaik hatilah kepada kami! \q Orang-orang telah merendahkan kami lebih dari yang dapat kami tahan.

tl.L: Pakitaan {{deity_pronoun:mo|Mo}} kami ng biyaya, O {{divine_name:PANGINOON|Yahweh}}, pakitaan {{deity_pronoun:mo|Mo}} kami ng biyaya, \q sapagkat lubos kaming napuno ng paghamak.
tl.B: Pakitaan {{deity_pronoun:mo|Mo}} kami ng biyaya, O {{divine_name:PANGINOON|Yahweh}}, pakitaan {{deity_pronoun:mo|Mo}} kami ng biyaya, \q sapagkat higit na paghamak ang aming nalunok kaysa makakaya namin.
tl.R: O {{divine_name:PANGINOON|Yahweh}}, maging mabait {{deity_pronoun:ka|Ka}} sa amin! Maging mabait {{deity_pronoun:ka|Ka}} sa amin! \q Minaliit kami ng mga tao nang higit sa kaya naming tiisin.

decisions.choice: filled with contempt: had too much of it
decisions.reason: To be "filled" or "sated" with something is to have had more than enough of it. Here the people have been made to swallow contempt until they can take no more.

decisions.choice: contempt: being despised
decisions.reason: The word (buz) is scorn shown to people treated as worthless (Nehemiah 3:36 has the same complaint).

decisions.choice: People have looked down on us
decisions.reason: Readable says who showed contempt and what it was.

decisions.choice: "저희" for "us" in prayer
decisions.reason: "저희" is the humble form of "우리" that Korean uses when a group speaks to a superior; it goes with "저" and 합쇼체.

decisions.choice: chonnenu repeated "あわれんでください" (L), "恵みを示してください" (B), "やさしくしてください！" (R); buz "さげすみ" (L, B), "見下されて" (R)
decisions.reason: Requests to God 〜てください at every level (Psalter rule); the doubled plea is kept at every level.

decisions.choice: "kami" when the worshipers speak to God
decisions.reason: Spoken to God, the "we" leaves the hearer out, so exclusive "kami" (verses 3-4), where verse 2 said "kita".

decisions.choice: "biyaya"
decisions.reason: Favor: grace (m1).

source.text: רַבַּת֮ שָֽׂבְעָה־לָּ֪הּ נַ֫פְשֵׁ֥נוּ הַלַּ֥עַג הַשַּׁאֲנַנִּ֑ים הַ֝בּ֗וּז לִגְאֵ֥יוֹנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Much has it been filled for itself, our soul, [with] the mockery of the ones at ease, the contempt of the proud.

en.L: Our soul has been greatly filled for itself \q [with] the mockery of those at ease, \q the contempt of the proud.
en.B: We have had our fill \q and more of the mockery of the comfortable \q and the contempt of the arrogant.
en.R: We are tired of being mocked by people with easy lives, \q and of being looked down on by proud people.

fr.L: Notre âme a été grandement rassasiée pour elle-même \q de la moquerie de ceux qui sont tranquilles, \q du mépris des orgueilleux.
fr.B: Nous en avons plus qu’assez \q de la moquerie des gens satisfaits \q et du mépris des arrogants.
fr.R: Nous sommes fatigués que des gens \q à la vie facile se moquent de nous, \q et que des orgueilleux nous regardent de haut.

sw.L: Nafsi yetu imeshibishwa sana dhihaka ya wale wanaostarehe, \q dharau ya wenye kiburi.
sw.B: Tumeshiba na kupita kiasi dhihaka ya watu wanaoishi kwa raha \q na dharau ya wenye majivuno.
sw.R: Tumechoka kudhihakiwa na watu wenye maisha ya raha, \q na kudharauliwa na watu wenye kiburi.

es.L: Muy harta está nuestra alma de la burla \q de los que viven tranquilos, \q del desprecio de los soberbios.
es.B: Ya estamos más que hartos de la burla \q de los que viven cómodos \q y del desprecio de los arrogantes.
es.R: Estamos cansados de que se burle de nosotros la gente que vive sin problemas, \q y de que nos desprecie la gente orgullosa.

vi.L: Linh hồn chúng tôi đã bị no nê quá nhiều sự chế nhạo của những kẻ an nhàn, \q sự khinh miệt của những kẻ kiêu ngạo.
vi.B: Chúng tôi đã chịu quá đủ sự chế nhạo của những kẻ sống an nhàn \q và sự khinh miệt của những kẻ kiêu căng.
vi.R: Chúng tôi đã mệt mỏi vì bị những kẻ sống sung sướng chế giễu, \q và bị những kẻ kiêu ngạo coi thường.

ko.L: 저희 영혼이 안일한 자들의 조롱과 교만한 자들의 멸시로 \q 너무나 배불러졌습니다.
ko.B: 저희는 안락하게 사는 자들의 비웃음과 거만한 자들의 멸시를 넘치도록 받았습니다.
ko.R: 저희는 편하게 사는 사람들에게 놀림받는 것도, \q 교만한 사람들에게 무시당하는 것도 지쳤습니다.

pt.L: Muito farta está a nossa alma \q da zombaria dos despreocupados, \q do desprezo dos soberbos.
pt.B: Já tivemos mais do que o bastante \q da zombaria dos acomodados \q e do desprezo dos arrogantes.
pt.R: Estamos cansados de ver gente \q de vida fácil zombar de nós \q e gente orgulhosa nos desprezar.

am.L: ነፍሳችን የተደላደሉትን ሰዎች መሣለቂያ፣ \q የትዕቢተኞችን ንቀት \q ለራሷ እጅግ ጠግባለች።
am.B: በተመቻቸው ሰዎች ፌዝና በትዕቢተኞች ንቀት \q ከልክ በላይ ጠግበናል።
am.R: ኑሮ በተመቻቸላቸው ሰዎች መሣለቅ ደክመናል፤ \q ትዕቢተኞችም ሲንቁን ሰልችቶናል።

hi.L: हमारा प्राण अपने लिए बहुत भर गया है, \q चैन से रहनेवालों के ठट्ठों से, \q घमंडियों के तिरस्कार से।
hi.B: निश्चिंत लोगों के उपहास से \q और घमंडियों के तिरस्कार से \q हम हद से ज़्यादा भर चुके हैं।
hi.R: हम इससे थक गए हैं कि आराम की ज़िंदगी जीनेवाले लोग हमारा मज़ाक़ उड़ाते हैं, \q और घमंडी लोग हमें नीचा दिखाते हैं।

ru.L: Сильно пресытилась душа наша \q насмешками беспечных, \q презрением гордых.
ru.B: Мы сыты по горло \q насмешками самодовольных \q и презрением надменных.
ru.R: Мы устали от того, что над нами смеются люди, которым легко живётся, \q и что гордецы смотрят на нас свысока.

ja.L: わたしたちの魂は、十分すぎるほど満たされた、 \q 安楽な者たちの嘲りに、 \q 高ぶる者たちのさげすみに。
ja.B: わたしたちは、安楽に暮らす者たちの嘲りと、 \q おごり高ぶる者たちのさげすみを、 \q いやというほど味わってきた。
ja.R: わたしたちは、楽な暮らしをしている人たちにからかわれ、 \q 高慢な人たちに見下されることに、 \q もう疲れ果てた。

uk.L: Наша душа дуже наситилася глузуванням безтурботних, \q зневагою гордих.
uk.B: Ми досхочу і понад міру наїлися глузування ситих \q і зневаги зарозумілих.
uk.R: Ми втомилися від того, що з нас глузують люди, \q яким легко живеться, \q і що на нас зверхньо дивляться горді.

id.L: Jiwa kami sudah terlalu kenyang \q [dengan] olok-olok orang-orang yang hidup senang, \q [dengan] penghinaan orang-orang yang congkak.
id.B: Kami sudah kenyang, \q bahkan lebih dari kenyang, dengan ejekan orang-orang yang hidup nyaman \q dan penghinaan orang-orang yang sombong.
id.R: Kami sudah lelah diejek oleh orang-orang yang hidupnya enak \q dan direndahkan oleh orang-orang yang sombong.

tl.L: Lubos nang napuno ang aming kaluluwa \q ng pangungutya ng mga panatag, \q ng paghamak ng mga palalo.
tl.B: Sawang-sawa na kami \q sa pangungutya ng mga maginhawa ang buhay \q at sa paghamak ng mga mapagmataas.
tl.R: Pagod na kami sa pagkutya ng mga taong maginhawa ang buhay, \q at sa pagmamaliit sa amin ng mga mapagmataas.

decisions.choice: those at ease: the complacent
decisions.reason: The word (sha'anan) means untroubled and secure. Here it describes people comfortable enough to look down on others (Amos 6:1; Isaiah 32:9).

decisions.choice: much ... filled: repeated from verse 3
decisions.reason: The verse takes up the end of verse 3, "much ... filled", and says what the contempt was and who showed it.

decisions.choice: our soul (L); we (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in Psalms 1-12, nefesh is "soul" at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "me" or "my life", since the word means the whole living person.

decisions.choice: душа наша (L); мы (B, R)
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, nefesh is душа at Literal; Balanced and Readable say "we" or "us" as the English level does, since the word means the whole living person.

decisions.choice: sha'anannim "安楽な者たち" (L), "安楽に暮らす者たち" (B), "楽な暮らしをしている人たち" (R); ge'eyonim "高ぶる者たち" (L), "おごり高ぶる者たち" (B), "高慢な人たち" (R)
decisions.reason: Those at ease are the complacent (m1); rabbat sav'ah repeats verse 3 (m2), kept as 十分すぎるほど満たされた at L in both verses.

decisions.choice: "mga panatag"
decisions.reason: Those at ease: the complacent (m1).
